2.title: Quest Cards: wrap and gap
2.learningObjective: Let flex items wrap onto additional rows while maintaining consistent spacing.
2.description: Style `.quest-list` so quest cards form a row, wrap when space is limited, and keep a 12px gap.
instructions: Give each `.quest` a flexible basis so cards can share available space.
2.hint: Use `flex: 1 1 180px` on each card for a useful minimum starting width.
2.explanation: `flex-wrap` allows items to move to another line instead of shrinking indefinitely. `gap` provides spacing between both columns and rows.
